sourceFile: 58. TIU L5S3-01 R Report  test Frame new mold #3 Set 3,4 - Date 2026.01.12_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but mislabels the changed factor and omits/overstates key outcomes.
issues: Changed factor should be new mold #3 set 3,4 test vs normal, not Normal vs Line R.
Line R is a line/grouping key, not the changed condition.
Assembly Sub 3 NG comparison is omitted from outcomes.
Function result is overcalled as improved despite near-equal NG and final same-normal decision.
Tension spec and sample count are extracted incorrectly.
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to new mold #3 set 3,4 test frame versus normal line/condition.
Set baseline as Normal and changed condition as Test/new mold; keep Line R and date as subgroup keys.
Add Assembly Sub 3 NG outcome using rows 18-21.
Revise function judgement to same/comparable or not materially different.
Fix tension spec to 0.3 kgf and sample count to 8 per condition; cite rows 31-35.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are mostly sufficient for context, but outcome headers and omitted assembly rows must be included before final use.
